same_lobe_technical_compatibility.matching_basis: Same documented donor, same anatomically named lung lobe, same reference assembly; bulk-tissue ATAC and histone evidence.
same_lobe_technical_compatibility.biosample_caveat: ATAC and ChIP biosample accessions differ within every lobe. Same-lobe compatibility must not be described as matched aliquots or cell-level co-occurrence.
same_lobe_technical_compatibility.lab_caveat: ATAC experiments are from Michael Snyder, Stanford; histone ChIP experiments are from Bradley Bernstein, Broad. Same-lobe comparison does not remove assay/laboratory technical differences.
same_lobe_technical_compatibility.lower_right_H3K27me3: ENCSR930JRJ has a low-read-depth warning. Retain and flag under the prespecified all-compatible-lobes construction; do not exclude based on model or external outcomes. Absence of a peak is an operational assay-negative label, not proof of biological absence.
same_lobe_technical_compatibility.histone_controls: All six selected histone experiments carry missing controlled_by warnings in the frozen local metadata snapshot. This is a technical caveat, not evidence that read-level controls were proven absent.

reference_and_annotations.repeatmasker_raw_schema: UCSC rmsk table: zero-based columns 5,6,7 are chrom,start,end; columns 10,11,12 are repeat name,class,family.
reference_and_annotations.signal_availability: All 745045 canonical ATAC rows have positive narrowPeak signalValue in column 7. This is peak-level assay signal, not a per-base bigWig or directly calibrated absolute accessibility across libraries. Prefer within-source-lobe ranks for matching.

V1_input_paths.control_provenance_limitation: Global pooled DHS-derived windows; not a donor-accessible control definition. The filename alone cannot establish contributing donor, tissue, or assay source for each row.

query_definitions.overlap: Positive-length intersection: interval_start < query_end and interval_end > query_start; at least 1bp.
query_definitions.summit: ATAC start+column10 when summit offset >=0; otherwise floor((start+end)/2).
query_definitions.window_identity: (chromosome,summit-500,summit+500); exact genomic interval identity, not mere overlapping flanks.
query_definitions.historical_positive: Original ATAC peak overlaps any relevant mark peak from any of three donor lobes. Window passes original 1kb blacklist and GENCODE gene-TSS +/-2kb filters, start>=501; exact summit windows deduplicated.
query_definitions.same_lobe_positive: A frozen V1 positive window has at least one original source ATAC peak with EXACT matching summit-window identity and >=1bp overlap with the relevant mark in that SAME lobe. Union eligible windows across lobes; preserve all supporting lobe/file identities, count each exact window once.
query_definitions.cross_lobe_only: Frozen V1 positive with all-lobe support but zero qualifying same-lobe source ATAC/histone pairs at its exact window identity.
query_definitions.support_histogram: Number of distinct same-lobe co-occurrence-supporting lobes per frozen V1 positive window, values0-3. Multiple technical/source observations in a lobe count once.
query_definitions.ATAC_accessible_1kb: V1 control [s,e) overlaps >=1bp of any canonical donor ATAC peak in any of three lobes.
query_definitions.ATAC_accessible_actual2001bp: V1 control [s-501,e+500) overlaps >=1bp of any donor ATAC peak.
query_definitions.ATAC_accessible_original_center: V1 1kb midpoint [s+500,s+501) overlaps a donor ATAC peak; this is the original summit convention, not an assertion that V1 controls were summit-centered in donor ATAC.
query_definitions.input_offset_caveat: Historical 1000bp BED expansion [s-501,e+500) makes a 2001bp sequence whose zero-based central base is s+499, one base left of the original summit s+500. Preserve the frozen V1 coordinate rule for the staged comparison and document it explicitly.
query_definitions.mark_contamination: Control overlap with the same-model relevant histone union tested separately at1kb and full2001bp. H3K27ac is tested only for enhancer controls; H3K27me3 only for that model.
query_definitions.efficient_overlap_implementation: Per chromosome sort interval starts and prefix maxima of ends; i=bisect_left(starts,query_end); overlap iff i>0 and prefix_max_end[i-1]>query_start. Counts computed directly from nine compressed source files and four frozen BEDs; no model predictions used.

construction_recommendations_from_inputs: Preserve all frozen V1 controls unchanged for V2-A, including documented accessibility deficit and full-window histone flank contamination.

For V2-B/C construct negatives around donor ATAC summits, require the original ATAC observation be mark-negative, and exclude relevant mark overlap across the actual2001bp input in every lobe. This conservatively prevents known relevant-mark positives from entering negative sequences.

Do not relabel cross-lobe-only positives as negatives merely because they fail same-lobe co-occurrence; exclude them from C positives and retain their documented marked context in negative exclusions.

Union same-lobe-supported exact windows across lobes once, retaining all provenance; audit near-overlapping windows and exact/RC sequence duplicates separately. Exact-window deduplication alone does not establish independence of near-identical loci.

Match accessible controls by chromosome, comparable source-lobe provenance, GC, within-lobe accessibility signal rank, and repeat burden with prespecified common-support diagnostics. Histone strength itself must not be matched away.

Audit blacklist/promoter status at both historical1kb and actual2001bp extents without silently changing V2-A or B positives. Any full-window exclusion that changes positives beyond the requested staged factor needs an explicit versioned decision.
Freeze source provenance and all internal data definitions before training. Do not change lobe inclusion, controls, or other design choices in response to external benchmark outcomes.
readiness: The required frozen interval, same-donor per-lobe peaks, peak-level accessibility signal, blacklist, repeatmasker, annotation and exact V1 reference sequence resources are locally available. Same-lobe labels and accessibility-confounding fractions are exactly quantifiable. Matching feasibility and sequence-level duplicate/availability QC require the main pretraining constructor; this independent audit does not claim those checks complete.
